description: This file contains a class `StandardSessionConnection` implementing session read/write/delete operations with DynamoDB, including handling session expiration and data attributes.

classes.name: StandardSessionConnection
classes.description: Implements session storage operations (read, write, delete, deleteExpired) for DynamoDB sessions, managing session attributes, expiration, and locking.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs the connection with a DynamoDB client and optional configuration.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads session data for a given session ID from DynamoDB.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes session data to DynamoDB, updating attributes and expiration time.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes session data for the specified session ID from DynamoDB.

methods.name: deleteExpired
methods.description: Finds and deletes expired session items from DynamoDB.

methods.name: formatKey
methods.description: Formats the session ID into the DynamoDB key structure.

methods.name: triggerError
methods.description: Handles error reporting, triggers a PHP warning.
